title: GANBLR Implementation
summary: A research codebase (ganblr_test.py) implementing and evaluating the GANBLR tabular data synthesis method, comparing its output against other synthesizers on train/test metrics. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer is fitted and sampled as a comparison baseline, and SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality are run to score synthetic data quality.
